newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Right-wing majority opposes idea of generalising an early retirement at 55, advocated by some as a means to fight unemployment.

-- Airbus partners sign agreement to shift to corporate status before end 1999. New corporation to control marketing policy, sales, engineering, flight tests, production, purchases and consumer services.

-- Aerospatiale chairman Yves Michot says in an interview that the ultimate aim of the planned shift in Airbus status is a restructuring of the whole European aircraft industry, to fend off U.S. competitors. Michot adds Aerospatiale expects to post a 550-million-franc profit for 1996.
-- Proposed cuts of working hours at EDF-GDF utilities divide labour unions.
